$comment: Guards are structural. Every leakage control in docs/04-EVALUATION.md is enforced here or in an MCP wrapper, never by prompt instruction. A prompt is a suggestion; a tool that refuses is a guarantee.

hooks.$comment: Refuses writes to tests/controls/ during an L2 run, and to benchmarks/ from any loop other than L0. Modifying a control to pass it is a hard error, not a judgement call.
In benchmark mode, refuses any retrieval without a resolved cutoff, and refuses egress to un-pinned live database hosts. Leaks L1 and L2.
Blocks curl/wget to live database endpoints during a benchmark run; snapshots only. Also blocks any invocation of scripts/unseal.py from inside an agent - unsealing requires an interactive human.
Validates any written EvidenceItem / Hypothesis / TargetDossier against its schema. Unvalidated data crossing an agent boundary is how agentic pipelines silently corrupt.
L1/L2 refuse to start in a session that has touched post-cutoff sources. The curator (L0) may read post-cutoff data; nothing that scores may.
